# Get the data

```{r}
# Get antimicrobial resistance genes
data_ARG <- read.delim(file = "../Data/CombinedTableAllARGs_by_gene.txt", 
                       sep = "\t", 
                       header = TRUE,
                       check.names = FALSE) %>% 
  select(-"88_S106", -"86_S76") 

# Grab the Gene names

data_disin <- read.delim(file = "../Data/CombinedTableAllARGs_disinfectant_FirstRun.txt", 
                         sep = "\t", 
                         header = TRUE,
                         check.names = FALSE) %>% 
  select(-"88_S106", -"86_S76")
```

# Plot the heat map for wild v. *ex-situ*

```{r}
# Factor Wild and ex-situ so that everything in the plots order correctly
meta_test <- metadata_mt_select %>% 
  mutate(Specific_Group = factor(.$Specific_Group, levels = c("Wild", "Ex-situ"))) %>% 
  select(Fastq_name, Animal_Code, Specific_Group)


data_plot <- data_ARG %>% 
  select(X,any_of(meta_test$Fastq_name)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "X") %>% 
  filter(rowSums(across()) > 0) %>% # Remove Accessions that weren't identified anywhere
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), # Convert Identity to Presence/Absence
                ~ifelse(.x > 0, "Present","Absent"))) %>% 
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Fastq_name") %>%
  left_join(., meta_test, by = "Fastq_name") %>% 
  select(-Fastq_name, -Specific_Group) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "Animal_Code") %>% 
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "X")

# Make it a graphable variable
data_plot$lineage <- as.factor(data_plot$X)
data_plot <- melt(data_plot[,2:ncol(data_plot)], id.vars = "lineage") %>% 
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = sample_order_animal))

# Need extra variable to get the color bars into my ggplot
group_bar <- meta_test %>%
  mutate(Animal_Code = factor(Animal_Code, levels = sample_order_animal)) %>%
  mutate(lineage = rep(0, 13)) %>% 
  select(-Fastq_name)

# Plot
ggplot(data = data_plot, aes(x = variable, y = lineage, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "ARG is:",
    values = c("blue4", "orange1"),  # for the tile fill
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1) # So the legend orders correctly
  ) +
  new_scale_fill() + # ---- reset fill scale here ----
  geom_tile(
    data = group_bar,
    aes(x = Animal_Code, y = lineage, fill = Specific_Group),
    height = 0.9,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Group:",
    values = c(
      "Wild"    = "#99FF33",
      "Ex-situ" = "#A6A6A6"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Wild" =  expression(italic("In-situ")),
      "Ex-situ" = expression(italic("Ex-situ"))
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2) # So the legend orders correctly
  ) +
  xlab("Animal") + ylab("Antibiotic Resistance Gene") + 
  ggtitle("*In-situ* v. *ex-situ* mt. tapirs ARG presence/absence") + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90), 
        plot.title = element_markdown())

# Save the image
ggsave(file = "../Images/ARG_WvE.pdf",
       width=6,
       height=3.6)
ggsave(file = "../Images/ARG_WvE.svg",
       width=6,
       height=3.6)
ggsave(file = "../Images/ARG_WvE.png",
       width=6,
       height=3.6)
```

# Validation of main ResFinder results with ARGs-OAP

## Get data, Total ARG abundance and richness plots and statistical tests

```{r}
# Using the ARGs-OAP ARG per cell normalization data which is provided as default output from the program
df <- read.delim(file = "../Data/ARG_OAP_outs/normalized_cell.subtype.txt", 
                  sep = "\t", 
                  header = TRUE,
                  check.names = FALSE) %>% 
  select(subtype,metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "subtype") %>% 
  filter(rowSums(across()) > 0) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() #Samples are rows. ARGs are columns

# Make the metadata factored
metadata_mt_select <- metadata_mt_select %>%
  mutate(Specific_Group = factor(Specific_Group, levels = c("Wild", "Ex-situ"))) 

# Total abundance analysis  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Figure ############################

stopifnot(identical(rownames(df), metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name))  # same sample order

# We sum the normalized values to get total ARG abundance for each sample
metadata_mt_select$total_ARG <- rowSums(df) 

p_total <- plot_mt_select(
  data = metadata_mt_select,
  variable = "total_ARG",
  x.ax = "Total ARG abundance",
  legend.pos = "none"
)

p_total

#ggsave("../Data/ARG_OAP_outs/All_ARGs_combined_boxplot.png", p_total,
#       width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 1200)

## Wilcoxon test ######################

coin::wilcox_test(total_ARG ~ Specific_Group, 
                  data = metadata_mt_select,
                  distribution = "exact")


# Richness assessment ---------------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_mt_select$richness <- specnumber(df)

## Figure ############################

p_arg_rich <-plot_mt_select(metadata_mt_select, "richness", "Richness", legend.pos = "right") # from the alpha diversity script
p_arg_rich

#ggsave("../Data/ARG_OAP_outs/ARG_richness_boxplot.png", p_arg_rich,
#       width = 4, height = 4, dpi = 1200)

## Wilcoxon test ######################

# Are the medians different between wild and ex-situ?
coin::wilcox_test(richness ~ Specific_Group, 
            data = metadata_mt_select,
            distribution = "exact")


```

## Heatmap 

```{r}

data_plot <- df %>% 
  select(results$feature[results$fdr_p_value < 0.05])

new_names <- metadata_mt_select$Animal_Code[match(rownames(data_plot),
                                                  metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name)]
sum(is.na(new_names))   # must be 0 before continuing
rownames(data_plot) <- new_names

data_plot <- data_plot %>% 
  t() %>% # Need ARGs to be rows
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "X")



sample_order <- c("WMT1","WMT2","WMT3","WMT4","WMT5","WMT6","ZMT1","ZMT2","ZMT3",
                  "ZMT4","ZMT5","ZMT6","ZMT7")

library(reshape2)
data_plot$lineage <- as.factor(data_plot$X)
data_plot <- melt(data_plot[,2:ncol(data_plot)], id.vars = "lineage") %>% 
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = sample_order))

data_plot$value[data_plot$value == 0] <- NA

rng <- range(data_plot$value, na.rm = TRUE)

na_cells <- data_plot %>% filter(is.na(value))

p_heat <- ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = lineage, y = variable, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +

  # invisible layer that only exists to create the second legend
  geom_point(
    data = na_cells,
    aes(x = lineage, y = variable, color = "zero"),
    shape = 15, alpha = 0, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours  = c("#FFFFCC", "#A1DAB4", "#41B6C4", "#2C7FB8", "#253494"),
    values   = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.02, 0.1, 0.4, 1) * rng[2], from = rng),
    name     = "Abundance",
    na.value = "grey45"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "0 value", values = c("zero" = "grey45")) +

  guides(
    fill  = guide_colorbar(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2,
                         label = FALSE,   # gray box only, no text beside it
                         override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 6, shape = 15))
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_discrete(
  labels = function(x) {
    x <- sub(".*_", "", x)                      # your existing cleanup

    # special case: yojI label
    x[grepl("yojI", x)] <- "YojI"

    # build plotmath expressions for each label
    lapply(x, function(lab) {
      if (grepl("Escherichia coli", lab)) {
        rest <- trimws(sub("Escherichia coli", "", lab))
        if (nchar(rest) > 0) {
          bquote(italic("E. coli") ~ .(rest))
        } else {
          bquote(italic("E. coli"))
        }
      } else {
        lab
      }
    })
  }
) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
```

```{r}
# Test that the order is the same

# Get the p-value
set.seed(1025)
adonis2(data_beta_Jac_df ~ Group, 
        data = metadata_mt_select, 
        permutations = 10000, 
        by = "margin")

##  Beta dispersion test ######################

                        metadata_mt_select$Group)
# 2) Actually give me a p-value to assess results
set.seed(1025)
permutest(bray_disp_Jac, 
          permutations = how(nperm=10000))
# 3) Show me a beta dispersion plot
plot(bray_disp_Jac, main = "Jaccard")
```

## Venn diagram of ARGs shared and unique to ex-situ and in-situ

```{r}
library(tidyr)

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)

futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")

# Soft colors similar to the paper (yellow-green, sky blue, purple)
venn_cols <- c("#99FF33", "#A6A6A6", "#2EC4B6")


# ---- Load your table (EDIT) ---------------------------------------------------
# amr <- read.csv("abundance_table.csv", row.names = 1)

# ---- Groups: 87_S105 removed from W and treated separately --------------------
group_W   <- c("10_S5", "9_S4", "6_S3", "1_S1", "2_S2")
group_Z   <- c("33_S25", "31_S23", "49_S41", "48_S40", "19_S12", "37_S29", "35_S27")
sample_W5 <- "87_S105"

stopifnot(
  "Some group_W names not found in rownames" = all(group_W %in% rownames(amr)),
  "Some group_Z names not found in rownames" = all(group_Z %in% rownames(amr)),
  "WMT5 not found in rownames"            = sample_W5 %in% rownames(amr)
)

# ---- Detection thresholds ------------------------------------------------------
min_reads   <- 0   # count must be greater than this to be "present"
min_samples <- 1   # samples per group (W and Z) that must have the ARG

detected_in <- function(df, samples, min_samples) {
  sub <- df[samples, , drop = FALSE]
  names(sub)[colSums(sub > min_reads, na.rm = TRUE) >= min_samples]
}

args_W  <- detected_in(df, group_W, min_samples)
args_Z  <- detected_in(df, group_Z, min_samples)
# A single sample can't satisfy min_samples = 3, so only the read threshold applies
args_W5 <- detected_in(df, sample_W5, 1)

# ---- Helper: pad lists into side-by-side columns ------------------------------
side_by_side_tbl <- function(lists) {
  n_rows <- max(lengths(lists), 1)
  as_tibble(lapply(lists, function(x) c(sort(x), rep(NA_character_, n_rows - length(x)))))
}

# ---- Table 1: W vs Z (without 87_S105) ----------------------------------------
side_by_side <- side_by_side_tbl(list(
  `Unique to W`   = setdiff(args_W, args_Z),
  `Unique to Z`   = setdiff(args_Z, args_W),
  `Found in both` = intersect(args_W, args_Z)
))
side_by_side

# ---- Table 2: where 87_S105 falls relative to W and Z -------------------------
w5_table <- tibble(ARG = args_W5) %>%
  mutate(
    in_W = ARG %in% args_W,
    in_Z = ARG %in% args_Z,
    category = case_when(
      in_W & in_Z  ~ "Shared with W and Z",
      in_W & !in_Z ~ "Shared with W only",
      !in_W & in_Z ~ "Shared with Z only",
      TRUE         ~ "Unique to 87_S105"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(category, ARG)

count(w5_table, category)

w5_side_by_side <- side_by_side_tbl(list(
  `Shared with W only`  = w5_table$ARG[w5_table$category == "Shared with W only"],
  `Shared with Z only`  = w5_table$ARG[w5_table$category == "Shared with Z only"],
  `Shared with W and Z` = w5_table$ARG[w5_table$category == "Shared with W and Z"],
  `Unique to 87_S105`   = w5_table$ARG[w5_table$category == "Unique to 87_S105"]
))
w5_side_by_side

# ---- Three-circle Venn --------------------------------------------------------
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")

grid.newpage()
venn3 <- draw.triple.venn(
  area1 = length(args_W),
  area2 = length(args_Z),
  area3 = length(args_W5),
  n12   = length(intersect(args_W, args_Z)),
  n23   = length(intersect(args_Z, args_W5)),
  n13   = length(intersect(args_W, args_W5)),
  n123  = length(Reduce(intersect, list(args_W, args_Z, args_W5))),
  category = c("In-situ", "Ex-situ", "WMT5"),
  # circles: filled, transparent, NO outline
  fill  = venn_cols,
  alpha = 0.6,
  lty   = rep("solid", 3),
  col = rep("white", 3),
  # counts: plain black sans-serif
  cex        = 1,
  fontfamily = "arial",
  label.col        = "black",
 # set labels: regular weight, outside the circles
  cat.cex        = 1,
  cat.fontface   = c("italic","italic", "plain"),
  cat.fontfamily = "arial",
  cat.col        = "black",
  cat.dist       = c(0.07, 0.07, 0.05),
 
  euler.d = FALSE,    # equal-sized circles keep the small regions readable
  scaled  = FALSE,
  ind = FALSE,
 
 # Padding 
 margin = 0.1
)
grid.draw(venn3)

venn_panel <- wrap_elements(full = grobTree(venn3))
```

## Run the analysis (Wilcoxon on each feature)

```{r}
# "../Data/AMR++_data/SNPconfirmed_AMR_0.8gf_0.9qc_analytic_matrix_by_Group.csv"
#../Data/AMR++_data/SNPconfirmed_AMR_0.8gf_0.8qc_analytic_matrix_by_Group.csv

  df <- read.delim(file = "../Data/ARG_OAP_outs/normalized_cell.subtype.txt", 
                  sep = "\t", 
                  header = TRUE,
                  check.names = FALSE) %>% 
  select(subtype,metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "subtype") %>% 
#  zero_below(., 3) %>%
  filter(rowSums(across()) > 0) %>% 
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

library(dplyr)
library(hilldiv)
library(coin)
library(tibble)

# ---- Group labels from metadata -----------------------------------------
# df must have sample names as rownames (matching metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name).
# If sample names are in a column instead, move them first:
# df <- df %>% column_to_rownames("sample_id")

group <- metadata_mt_select$Group[match(rownames(df), metadata_mt_select$Fastq_name)]

# Recode to the labels used downstream ("Wild" = in-situ)
group <- factor(
  dplyr::case_when(
    tolower(group) == "ex-situ" ~ "ex-situ",
    tolower(group) == "wild"    ~ "in-situ",
    TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c("ex-situ", "in-situ")
)

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(!anyNA(group))             # every sample was found and recognized
stopifnot(length(group) == nrow(df))
print(table(group))                  # should show ex-situ = 7, in-situ = 6
# ---- Parameters --------------------------------------------------------
min_count <- 0     # a feature must have at least this many counts in a sample...
min_prev  <- 0.2   # ...in at least this proportion of samples to be retained
alpha     <- 0.05   # FDR cutoff for calling a feature "enriched"
pseudocount <- NULL # NULL = auto (half the smallest non-zero value); or set a number, e.g. 1e-6

# ---- 1. Count + prevalence filter ---------------------------------------
min_samples <- ceiling(min_prev * nrow(df))
keep        <- colSums(df >= min_count) >= min_samples # Identifies which genes satisfy the thresholds
df_filt     <- df[, keep, drop = FALSE] # Filters out the features that failed 

message(sum(keep), " of ", ncol(df), " features retained after filtering.") # Tell the user how many features are left

# ---- 2. TSS normalization ----------------------------------------------
# hilldiv::tss() expects features in rows and samples in columns, so transpose,
# normalize, and transpose back (samples in rows again).
#rel <- t(hilldiv::tss(t(df_filt)))
rel <- df_filt
#stopifnot(all(abs(rowSums(rel) - 1) < 1e-8))  # check that each sample sums to 1

# Pseudocount to avoid log(0) in the fold change
if (is.null(pseudocount)) {
  pseudocount <- min(rel[rel > 0]) / 2
}
message("Using pseudocount = ", signif(pseudocount, 3))


# ---- 3. Wilcoxon rank-sum test (coin) per feature -----------------------
results <- lapply(colnames(rel), function(feat) {
  d <- data.frame(abundance = rel[, feat], group = group)

  wt <- coin::wilcox_test(abundance ~ group, data = d,
                          distribution = coin::exact())

  # Direction of enrichment: compare mean ranks between groups
  r       <- rank(d$abundance)
  mr_ex   <- mean(r[d$group == "ex-situ"])
  mr_in   <- mean(r[d$group == "in-situ"])
  
  # Log2 fold change: in-situ relative to ex-situ
  # (positive = higher in in-situ, negative = higher in ex-situ)
  mean_ex <- mean(d$abundance[d$group == "ex-situ"])
  mean_in <- mean(d$abundance[d$group == "in-situ"])
  lfc     <- log2((mean_ex + pseudocount) / (mean_in + pseudocount))

  tibble(
    feature        = feat,
    LogFoldChange  = lfc,
    p_value        = as.numeric(coin::pvalue(wt)),
    higher_in      = if (mr_ex > mr_in) "ex-situ" else if (mr_in > mr_ex) "in-situ" else NA_character_
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# ---- 4. FDR correction + enrichment call --------------------------------
results <- results %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_p_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    enriched_in = if_else(fdr_p_value < alpha, higher_in, NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  select(feature, LogFoldChange,
         p_value, fdr_p_value, enriched_in) %>%
  arrange(fdr_p_value, p_value)

results

# Significant features only:
# results %>% filter(!is.na(enriched_in))

write.table(results, file = "../Data/ARG_OAP_outs/Wilcoxon_results_exsitu_vs_insitu_subtype.tsv",
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

```
